card.text: A-type star 2.64 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Sirius A is an A-type star 2.64 parsecs from the Sun and about 1.7 times its radius. The VLTI measured its disc at 6.04 milliarcseconds; here its surface is a plain sphere.

sources.label: Kervella et al. 2003
sources.quote: a limb darkened value of θLD = 6.039 ±0.019 mas

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Hubble's calibrated spectrum of the star. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.
